reason: After reviewing the filing excerpt (10-K for year ended December 31, 2025), CSX Corporation does not disclose any Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures. The filing contains detailed financial information, business descriptions, and operational metrics for their rail and trucking segments, but no TAM estimates or market size assessments are provided by the company itself. The document focuses on route-miles, service areas, financial performance, and operational details rather than addressable market sizing.
